experience.title: Graphic Designer
bullets: Produced 100+ digital and print creatives spanning employee engagement, branding, recruitment, onboarding, and corporate communications.
Built reusable design templates and visual systems that cut turnaround time and repetitive work.

Partnered directly with HR and management stakeholders, maintaining low revision cycles across projects.
Managed print-ready file production ensuring proper bleed, sizing, and colour accuracy.

Collaborated with developers and stakeholders on design-to-development handoff.
